Domestic & International Crossover Alignment
This advanced analysis evaluates how Domestic and International feeds interlock across the two systems. It builds a 4-way comparison "quad" by first pairing up records within each system using their identical keys, and then bringing those Domestic and International pairs together using their explicit crossover (Xover) references. This four-way view helps identify complex architectural differences, such as asymmetrical publishing patterns, missing crossover linkages, and payload drifts where one system might merge data that the other system splits.
